learner_results: A complete first-response Runbook separates observed facts, unknowns, hypotheses, next read-only checks, and escalation.
A cost and cleanup inventory keeps discovery separate from deletion authorization.
Cleanup order starts with Section resources and Kubernetes load-balancer owners, verifies fixed residuals, and removes the cleanup guard last.
Common EKS status validation exposes only a generic success line; raw success stdout remains in a private temporary file and is removed.

live_execution.reason: Live AWS use requires the exact CloudShell identity, intended account confirmation, fixed common EKS runtime binding, current pricing estimate, bounded use window, and deletion preflight.
